title: Single-pass JSON object emission
failure_signature: model restarts the object after beginning JSON output
model appends a second top-level object or preamble after the object begins
prompt_delta: Construct the response as one JSON object in one pass. Start with {, emit each required top-level key exactly once in the exact order specified below, then close the object with }. Do not emit format, required_fields_present, reason, or any other field as a preamble before this sequence. Do not restart the object, repeat a field, or append a second copy of any field after it has already been emitted. After reason, close the JSON object immediately. Emit no additional top-level key.
validator_expectations: response must be a single JSON object
top-level key order must be stable for generation
no second top-level object may be emitted
